features.quote: They were large, heavily built, herbivorous quadrupeds with rounded backs, short fore limbs, long hind limbs, and tails held high in the air.

features.claim: Stegosaurus had a double row of kite-shaped plates standing upright along its back.
features.quote: The quadrupedal Stegosaurus is one of the most easily identifiable dinosaur genera, due to the distinctive double row of kite-shaped plates rising vertically along the rounded back and the two pairs of long spikes extending horizontally near the end of the tail.

features.claim: Stegosaurus had two pairs of long spikes near the end of its tail.
features.quote: The quadrupedal Stegosaurus is one of the most easily identifiable dinosaur genera, due to the distinctive double row of kite-shaped plates rising vertically along the rounded back and the two pairs of long spikes extending horizontally near the end of the tail.

features.claim: Stegosaurus had a short neck and a small head.
features.quote: It had a short neck and a small head, meaning it most likely ate low-lying bushes and shrubs.

features.claim: Stegosaurus had a long and narrow skull.
features.quote: The long and narrow skull was small in proportion to the body.

features.claim: Stegosaurus had no front teeth and probably had a horny beak.
features.quote: This interpretation is supported by the absence of front teeth and their likely replacement by a horny beak or rhamphotheca.

features.claim: Stegosaurus had short fore limbs and long hind limbs.
features.quote: They were large, heavily built, herbivorous quadrupeds with rounded backs, short fore limbs, long hind limbs, and tails held high in the air.

features.claim: Each hind foot had three short toes and each fore foot had five toes.
features.quote: The hind feet each had three short toes, while each fore foot had five toes; only the inner two toes had a blunt hoof.

features.claim: Stegosaurus held its tail well clear of the ground.
features.quote: The tail appears to have been held well clear of the ground, while the head of Stegosaurus was positioned relatively low down, probably no higher than 1 m (3.3 ft) above the ground.

not_this.claim: Old pictures showed the plates lying flat on the back, but they actually stood upright.
not_this.quote: After finding a specimen that had been covered with mud, which had held the plates in place, Marsh realised that they stood vertically, alternately on either side of the spine.

not_this.claim: Old pictures showed a single row of plates, but the plates were in two staggered rows.
not_this.quote: Like Marsh's reconstruction, Knight's first restoration had a single row of large plates, though he next used a double row for his more well-known 1901 painting, produced under the direction of Frederic Lucas.

not_this.claim: Old pictures showed the tail spikes pointing vertically, but they actually stuck out horizontally.
not_this.quote: Discoveries of articulated stegosaur armor show, at least in some species, these spikes protruded horizontally from the tail, not vertically as is often depicted.

not_this.claim: Old pictures showed Stegosaurus as bipedal and long-necked, which was wrong.
not_this.quote: Jobin restored the Stegosaurus as bipedal and long-necked, with the plates arranged along the tail and the back covered in spikes.

debated.claim: The arrangement of the plates on the back may have varied between species.
debated.quote: In a 2010 review of Stegosaurus species, Peter Galton suggested that the arrangement of the plates on the back may have varied between species, and that the pattern of plates as viewed in profile may have been important for species recognition.

debated.claim: Whether Stegosaurus could rear up on its hind legs is disputed.
debated.quote: Although Stegosaurus is undoubtedly now considered to have been quadrupedal, some discussion has occurred over whether it could have reared up on its hind legs, using its tail to form a tripod with its hind limbs, to browse for higher foliage.

second_reading.claim: Stegosaurus had a small head and its brain was around the size of a plum.
second_reading.quote: Compared with the rest of its body, Stegosaurus had a small head and its brain was around the size of a plum!
